attributes.action: Reverse any decision or proposal to abolish or alter the Triple Lock Pension
attributes.additional_details: Protection against poverty  TLP was introduced in 2011 to reverse decades of declining pension value. Without it the fear is maintaining standard of living  Inability to increase income, retirees are on fixed incomes The UK state pension is among the lowest in G7  Financial certainty and peace of mind. The guarantee that provides predictable baseline security  Pensioners  view their pension as be funded by a lifetime of NI contributions and taxes    Abolishing the TLP will unfairly penalise them
attributes.background: Reverse any decision or proposal to abolish or alter the Triple Lock Pension.  The Triple Lock Pension currently ensures that older citizen are protected against rising living costs, helping to prevent pensioner poverty and maintaining dignity in retirement.  Many pensioners already face heat or eat
